thread:
anya: Quick design question — can we shrink the heatmap legend inside the p95 card and tuck a compact sampling handle into the time scrubber?
sam: curious — do you mean a separate mini-heatmap or the same heatmap compressed? :thinking_face:
matt: I mocked two options: a mini heatmap above the scrubber, and an inline thin-heatmap within the card. mini has more room for presets. attaching mock: https://figma.com/s/mini-heatmap
anya: saw the mock. mini looks promising for mobile too. main concerns: discoverability of sampling, and not obscuring sparkline.
leo: accessibility nit: the sampler pill needs a 44px min touch target and visible focus ring. also ensure keyboard access (tab + arrow).
aria: also need color contrast adjustments — at small sizes green/teal buckets fail AA. suggest darker hue for selected bucket and a stronger outline.
katie: copy thought: label should read 'Sampling rate' not 'Show sample'. tooltip: 'Percent of traces displayed to reduce noise' — wording feel?
sam: prefer 'Sampling rate' + transient numeric overlay while dragging (e.g., "10%" above pill). avoids clutter when idle.
matt: quick implementation note: we can do tooltip with CSS transform during drag. simple aria-live message for screen reader: `aria-live="polite"` announce "Sampling set to 10 percent".
leo: keyboard behavior proposal: left/right nudge 1%, shift+arrow 10%, enter to pin preset. aria-live should announce deltas, not raw values every small step.
aria: screenreader mapping: heatmap should be focusable; each bucket reads "bucket X: Y traces, selected". but we should avoid >50 focusable nodes per card. maybe expose a single control that cycles buckets in a listbox pattern.
anya: good point — cycle control might be better for SR. For sighted users, hovering shows tooltip with counts. For compact mode, we hide bucket labels to save space.
katie: microcopy tweak: change 'reduce noise' -> 'reduce noise for clearer latency patterns' keeps intent clearer.
sam: presets idea: 1%, 10%, 100% — quick switches for coarse comparison. also allow custom drag.
matt: implementation checklist for handoff: component tokens for focus state, 44px min hit area, color variables, tooltip timing. I'll add a compact variant called `mini-heatmap` in the component library.
anya: follow-ups: matt to update figma + handoff; leo/aria to run quick keyboard + SR sanity test on the prototype; katie to finalize copy for tooltip and subtitle.
prod-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap-sampler-preview (expires in 48h)
anya: awesome — once the preview is up let's run a 5-min lab with 3 folks and capture quick notes. thanks team :thumbsup:
